messages:
Alex P.: quick q on the streaming contract for chat/completions — PR #4123 proposes we emit function call deltas as separate chunks. current idea:

```
{ "type":"delta", "delta": { "role":"assistant", "content":"here's a sentence" } }
{ "type":"delta", "function_call": { "name":"search", "arguments":"{ \"q\": \"foo\" }" } }
{ "type":"done", "result": {...} }
```

Backcompat concerns: older clients expect a single `function_call` object in the final non-stream response. Do we keep the final `function_call` aggregation + also stream intermediate `function_call` deltas? Thoughts? :thinking_face:

Priya G.: I think we should keep the final aggregated `function_call` in the last chunk for backcompat. streaming deltas can be additive (append args) but spec needs to say: clients MUST assemble `function_call` by concatenating `arguments` from `function_call` deltas in order. mention in spec and tests.

Matt R.: Agree. Also suggest adding an explicit `delta_type` or `field` in the delta to avoid ambiguous merging. e.g.

```
{ "type":"delta", "delta": {"field":"function_call.arguments","value":"..."} }
```

That helps clients that do not want to parse partial JSON strings.

Jen L.: small UX note: streaming partial JSON for function args is painful for browser clients. If we mandate `arguments_chunk` (string) vs `arguments_json` (structured), we can support both. default to string chunks for models that stream raw text.

Alex P.: so plan:
- keep final `function_call` on last chunk (aggregated)
- allow streaming `function_call` deltas, with an explicit `field` tag
- document assembly rules + examples

Anyone object? If not I'll update PR and add test harness.

Priya G.: no objections. Add a unit test simulating a network split where a few deltas drop — we must document that clients SHOULD be resilient to missing chunks (best-effort reconstruction) and servers SHOULD try to re-send missing segments on reconnect when possible.

Matt R.: also check `content-type: application/json-seq` examples. For SSE/HTTP2 streaming we need to show both JSON-lines and SSE formats in the spec doc.

Alex P.: good call — I'll add examples for `text/event-stream` and `application/json-seq`.

ci-bot: PR #4123 — head build passed ✅ (linux, unit) — integration tests pending.

Jen L.: pinging @Matt R. and @Priya G. for code review on the spec doc and the streaming examples. also would be great to get a short blurb for the changelog about compatibility guarantees.

Matt R.: taking a look now, will comment inline. :eyes:

Priya G.: lgtm for the assembly rules, will add a paragraph about telemetry fields we can emit to measure client reconstruction failure rates.

deploy-bot: reminder: deprecations require 30 days notice in the `/announcements` channel and a migration guide. :bell:

Alex P.: noted — will draft migration guide and post to announcements once we land the PR. thanks everyone.

Jen L.: small follow-up — should we add a `partial: true` flag to streamed `function_call` deltas to make it explicit when chunking is happening? avoids guessing. :thumbsup:

Matt R.: +1 for `partial: true`. make it optional (default true when chunking), and servers may omit when emitting full structured `function_call` in one chunk.

Alex P.: perfect. I'll update PR and add tests + example clients (node/python). code review ping when ready. thanks! :rocket:
